headline: On October 29, 1998: ATSC HDTV broadcasting launches in the US
captionCards: ATSC HDTV launched with live STS-95 shuttle coverage
Laid the groundwork for modern digital TV
instagramCaption:
ATSC HDTV broadcasting makes its debut in the United States. 
On this day, the Advanced Television Systems Committee (ATSC) standards were inaugurated with live coverage of the STS-95 space shuttle mission. This marked a significant shift from analog NTSC to digital television. Surprisingly, while ATSC is widely used in the US, Mexico, Canada, South Korea, and Trinidad and Tobago, other countries like Japan adopted different systems. 
This transition laid the groundwork for modern digital TV.
